scenario_initialization.description: The AAV5 preset couples its declared receptor-total parameters with all 65 nonzero free receptor starting coordinates. The retained -1000 h equilibration precedes the bolus at 0 h. Blood-cell and tissue receptor coordinates use their respective declared totals.
scenario_initialization.limitation: Receptor-total parameters are initialization inputs and do not occur in the derivative equations. Changing one parameter alone in a research request does not reinitialize its receptor states. Use a named serotype preset or explicitly update the coupled initial states.
scenario_initialization.scope: Source numerical coordinates; physical-unit qualification and author-control-stream reproduction are not established.

entries.rationale: The printed equations use plasma concentrations while declaring Y as Plasma or Lymph. This implementation evaluates association and dissociation with concentrations in the named local compartment. This is a disclosed locality interpretation; the author control stream has not been checked.
entries.conservation_implications: The binding contribution cancels in antibody plus complex and target plus complex for either convention. That stoichiometric cancellation does not certify whole-body conservation, physical dimensions or positivity. A plasma-driven lymph reaction can consume local species without local reactant availability.
entries.qualification_limits: A literal printed-plasma reconstruction and a local-lymph reconstruction represent distinct source conventions. Neither is rejected as scientifically incorrect solely for this choice. Complete author-code, dimensional and whole-body conservation qualification remain open.

barrier_parameters.description: BBB and BCSFB reflection inputs are separate for AAV vector and proteins. sigma_vector_bbb and sigma_vector_bcsfb affect AAV equations; sigma_protein_bbb and sigma_protein_bcsfb affect mAb, TargetX and their complex together. A protein-only perturbation leaves all vector equation coefficients unchanged. A shared perturbation must explicitly set both vector and protein inputs and therefore affects AAV, mAb, TargetX and complex.
barrier_parameters.source_locator: Liu 2026, DOI 10.1007/s10928-026-10051-w, Table 1 page 11. The table prints separate modality superscripts with common BBB 0.9975 and BCSFB 0.9973 values.
barrier_parameters.limits: All four coefficients use unit 1, values from 0 through 1 and the retained source numerical scale. The protein profile deliberately groups mAb, TargetX and complex at their disclosed common barrier defaults; a TargetX-only perturbation is not represented. Other organ reflection, interstitial/CSF reflection, diffusion, receptor and transgene coordinates are unchanged. Complete source, author-code, physical-unit and whole-body conservation qualification remain open.
barrier_parameters.migration: Version 2.1.0 uses four explicit modality names. The ambiguous sigma_bbb and sigma_bcsfb inputs and their prior native source_symbol_872/source_symbol_873 names are unavailable. To reproduce a shared barrier perturbation, set both sigma_vector_bbb and sigma_protein_bbb, and both sigma_vector_bcsfb and sigma_protein_bcsfb. For a historical calculation use its exact pinned archive and request.
